title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Cerdena, Municipality of Malabuyoc, Cebu to be known as the Cerdena National High School and appropriating funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Cerdena, Municipality of Malabuyoc, Cebu to be known as the Cerdena National High School and appropriating funds therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Cerdena, Thị trấn Malabuyoc, Cebu được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Cerdena
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Cerdena, เทศบาล Malabuyoc, Cebu ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Cerdena
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Cerdena, Kotamadya Malabuyoc, Cebu dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Cerdena
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Cerdena, Perbandaran Malabuyoc, Cebu dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Cerdena

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay Cerdena, Municipality of Malabuyoc, Cebu to be known as the Cerdena National High School.

The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall take the necessary steps for the establishment of the school so as to make it operational during the first school term after the effectivity of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
